top_choice_rationale: Mircea Cărtărescu alone (P001) is the strongest whole-oeuvre case on the common criteria. Public knowledge of Blinding (the Orbitor sequence) and Solenoid points to a recognizable voice and to constructed long forms, with recurring image systems and nested structures, in which memory, the body and dream form one metaphysical project. The scale does formal work and is not mere length. The citation should rest on the prose, with poetry named only as a root, since translated coverage of the poetry is thin and the poetry-as-base claim is a hypothesis. The main unresolved risk is whether the late novels deepen or recirculate their image systems, and whether the Romanian prose's density and rhythm survive translation. These are limits of evidence and access, not findings against the work, so they do not justify P000. This rests on general public knowledge and colleagues' stated views, not on independent verification or my having read the works. The unanimous round-2 support is not treated as merit.
